messages:
Priya S: quick async check-in — audits + IAM/KMS delegation. TL;DR: key rotation dry-run succeeded in staging, found one service account missing iam:PassRole, raising PR today. ping if this blocks you.

Alex P: nice. link to the dry-run logs? also want the runbook so infra can prep for the rotation window. :thumbsup:

Priya S: logs here: https://redwood.internal/logs/rotations/2026-02-28/dryrun-42 (view-only). runbook snippet below:

```
# KMS rotation runbook (excerpt)
- verify staging rotation: `./scripts/kms/rotate --dry-run --env=staging`
- confirm replicas: check `rotations/replica-status`
- fix missing roles: `gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding` (see step 4)
- post-check: ensure audit logs in SIEM for last 1h
```

Priya S: current blocker: Samir's service account for telemetry lacks `iam:PassRole` in the policy; without it some background jobs skip credential refresh. I opened PR #842 to add the binding.

Samir: yep, that's mine — I missed the delegation bit when creating the SA. PR #842 is up, tests pass locally but I'd like a quick CR for the binding change. snippet of policy I added:

```json
{"bindings": [{"role":"roles/iam.serviceAccountUser","members":["serviceAccount:telemetry@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]}]}
```

Samir: request: add `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` for the rotation helper too? otherwise rotate fails on token minting.

Jordan: quick compliance note — we need to keep KMS rotation audit logs for 2 years for EU customers. retention config lives at `infra/compliance/retention.yml` (I updated it last week). Make sure staging tests include retention header.

Alex P: I can review PR after 2pm PST today. If Samir can merge before the rotation window at 18:00 UTC, infra will schedule the staging->canary dry-run.

Samir: I'll address tokenCreator role in PR now, push a patch in ~20m. ping me if you need me to hold the merge.

sec-bot: [vuln-scan] 2026-02-28 10:12Z - Medium vulnerability found in dependency `google-apis-core` (CVE-2025-9991). Affected service: auth-service. See https://sec.redwood/cves/CVE-2025-9991 for details. Auto-ticket #INC-2145 created.

Priya S: thanks @sec-bot — linking INC-2145 here. action: Samir to add the role change + check vuln impact surface on auth-service (+@Jordan for audit retention confirmation).

Jordan: noted. I'll confirm retention headers & that SIEM ingests rotation audit events.

Alex P: FYI for Dedicated customers: if we change IAM bindings, we need to run the in-place validator to avoid service restarts. I'll add the validator job to the rotation checklist.

Priya S: plan for today: Samir to update PR (#842) with tokenCreator change and merge by 17:30 UTC; Alex to CR after 2pm PST; Jordan to confirm retention + SIEM; infra will schedule staging rotate at 18:00 UTC dry-run; if green we'll plan canary next week.

Priya S: any blockers? otherwise mark as done-for-day here. :white_check_mark:

Alex P: no blockers from infra side.

Samir: no blockers, will push patch soon.

Jordan: no blockers, will update `infra/compliance/retention.yml` commit id in this thread once done.
